name: BICYCLE_DISMOUNT_WHITE_SQUARE

gm9-58a_bicycle.desc: Bicycle symbol (side view, facing left), 424 x 280 box on a 50 grid; the bottom chain 117 | 366 | 117 gives a second (wheel-to-wheel?) extent of 366.

notes: 600x600, 25 black border. 80 | 280 bicycle | 75 | 85 C | 80 = 600. Bicycle box 88 | 424 | 88 (top chain); DISMOUNT centred, 85 C. FLAG: DISMOUNT is dimensioned 68 | 483 | 69, which sums to 620 for a 600 sign; 85 C gives 463 and 68 + 463 + 69 = 600 closes the chain, so the drawn 483 is a drawing typo (not width-checked). The 117 | 366 | 117 chain is not explained by the drawing (taken as a secondary extent of the symbol).
